import { parseCiTestArtifact, type CiTestArtifactInput, type CiTestArtifact, parseCiTestMetadata, type CiTestMetadataV1, type ParseResult } from '@loomake/core';
import {
  createAgreement, parseTrace, parseTasks, parseSpec, extractTestRequirements, VERIFY_RESULT_SCHEMA_VERSION, loadParserSchemas, TRACE_SCHEMA_VERSION, SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION, TASKS_SCHEMA_VERSION, loadTraceSchemas, type Evidence as CoreEvidence, type EvidenceDocument as CoreEvidenceDocument, type Report as CoreReport, type ReportRow as CoreReportRow,
  QUALITY_REPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION, loadQualityReportSchema, type QualityReport,
  type ParseError, type Trace, type LedgerRow, type QuestionRow, type AssumptionRow, type SpecOperation, type SpecRequirement, type Task, type VerifyResult, type VerifyCheckResult, type VerifyDecision,
  LEGACY_VERIFY_RESULT_SCHEMA_VERSION, type LegacyVerifyResult, type LegacyVerifyCheckResult, type LegacyEvidence,
} from '@loomake/core';
import { evaluateAgreement, evaluateTestCoverage, type AgreementDecision, type TestCoverageDecision, runVerify, formatVerifyResult, verifyExitCode, UsageError, type VerifyOptions, type QualityCommandOutcome } from '@loomake/kit';
import { runRecord, runReport, buildReport, EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION, type Evidence, type EvidenceDocument, type Report, type ReportRow } from '@loomake/trace';
import { runRun, maskSecrets, type RunOptions, type RunSummary } from '@loomake/runner';

type Equal<A, B> = (<T>() => T extends A ? 1 : 2) extends (<T>() => T extends B ? 1 : 2) ? true : false;
type Assert<T extends true> = T;
export function consumeCiTestArtifact(input: CiTestArtifactInput): ParseResult<CiTestArtifact> {
  return parseCiTestArtifact(input);
}
// REQ-318: 現行の verify 2.0.0 の検査は共有の 4 値、履歴の 1.0.0 は従来の 4 状態
export type StatusContract = Assert<Equal<VerifyCheckResult['result'], 'PASS' | 'FAIL' | 'INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE' | 'NOT_APPLICABLE'>>;
export type LegacyStatusContract = Assert<Equal<LegacyVerifyCheckResult['status'], 'pass' | 'fail' | 'warn' | 'skip'>>;

// 型チェックだけに使う利用側の例。呼び出してファイルやGitを変更しない。
export function consumePublicApi(root: string) {
  const metadata: ParseResult<CiTestMetadataV1 | null> = parseCiTestMetadata('metadata.json', '{}');
  const metadataVersion: 1 | undefined = metadata.value?.schemaVersion;
  void metadataVersion; // REQ-391: packaged public parser and type
  const error: ParseError = { file: 'trace.md', line: 1, message: '入力の確認' };
  const trace: Trace = parseTrace(error.file, '').value;
  const tasks: Task[] = parseTasks('tasks.md', '- [ ] task').value;
  const checked: boolean = tasks[0].checked;
  const specs = parseSpec('spec.md', '').value;
  const ids: Record<string, string[]> = extractTestRequirements('report.json', '{}').value;
  const decision: VerifyDecision = { required: false, reasons: [] };
  const verification: VerifyResult = {
    schemaVersion: VERIFY_RESULT_SCHEMA_VERSION, change: 'sample', run: { status: 'completed', errors: [] }, scope: 'local', checks: [],
    summary: { fail: 0, insufficient: 0, not_applicable: 0, evaluated: 0, pending: 0 }, decision,
  };
  const ok: boolean = verifyExitCode(verification) === 0;
  const legacy: LegacyVerifyResult = { schemaVersion: LEGACY_VERIFY_RESULT_SCHEMA_VERSION, mode: 'done', change: 'sample', ok: true, results: [] };
  const legacyEvidence: LegacyEvidence = { schemaVersion: 1, change: 'sample', sha: 'a', committedAt: '', recordedAt: '', verify: legacy };
  const options: VerifyOptions = { root, changeId: 'sample', gate: 'spec-only' };
  const verified: VerifyResult = runVerify(options);
  // REQ-456: 元のオプション利用を残し、追加の公開型を通知側でも使う。
  const outcomes: QualityCommandOutcome[] = [];
  const observing: VerifyOptions = { root, onCommand: outcome => outcomes.push(outcome) };
  const observed: VerifyResult = runVerify(observing);
  void observed;
  const text: string = formatVerifyResult(verified);
  const oldEvidence: Evidence = { schemaVersion: EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION, change: 'sample', sha: 'a', committedAt: '', recordedAt: '', verify: verification };
  const recorded: number = runRecord({ root, changeId: 'sample', stdout: () => {} });
  const reported: number = runReport({ root, changeId: 'sample', format: 'json', stdout: () => {} });
  const report: Report | undefined = buildReport(root, 'sample');
  const runOptions: RunOptions = { root, changeId: 'sample', interactive: false, confirm: async () => false, stdout: () => {} };
  const running: Promise<number> = runRun(runOptions);
  const summary: RunSummary = { change: 'sample', status: 'interrupted', reason: '', doneTasks: [], remainingTasks: [], lastVerify: null };
  const masked: string = maskSecrets(text);
  return { trace, checked, specs, ids, ok, oldEvidence, legacyEvidence, recorded, reported, report, running, summary, masked, error: new UsageError('設定の確認') };
}

// @ts-expect-error REQ-148: coreでは判定関数と結果型を公開しない。
import { evaluateAgreement as removedAgreement, type AgreementDecision as RemovedAgreement } from '@loomake/core';
// @ts-expect-error REQ-149: coreでは判定関数と結果型を公開しない。
import { evaluateTestCoverage as removedCoverage, type TestCoverageDecision as RemovedCoverage } from '@loomake/core';
export function consumePolicyApi(trace: Trace): [AgreementDecision, TestCoverageDecision] {
  return [evaluateAgreement(createAgreement('trace.md', trace).value), evaluateTestCoverage(['REQ-148'], {})];
}

// REQ-298・REQ-299: 配布されたスキーマ由来の型と遅延 loader だけを使う。
export async function consumeParserContracts(trace: Trace, spec: SpecRequirement[], tasks: Task[]) {
  const schemas = await loadParserSchemas();
  const versions: ['1.0.0', '1.0.0', '1.0.0'] = [TRACE_SCHEMA_VERSION, SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION, TASKS_SCHEMA_VERSION];
  const ledger: LedgerRow[] = schemas.traceSchema.parse(trace).ledger;
  const questions: QuestionRow[] = trace.questions;
  const assumptions: AssumptionRow[] = trace.assumptions;
  const operation: SpecOperation | null = schemas.specSchema.parse(spec)[0].op;
  const parsedTasks: Task[] = schemas.tasksSchema.parse(tasks);
  return { versions, ledger, questions, assumptions, operation, parsedTasks };
}

// REQ-302・REQ-303・REQ-304: 従来の公開元と導出型を同じ配布物から使う。
export async function consumeTraceContracts(evidence: Evidence, document: EvidenceDocument, report: Report, row: ReportRow) {
  const schemas = await loadTraceSchemas();
  const futureEvidence: CoreEvidence = { ...evidence, schemaVersion: 9.5 };
  const futureReport: CoreReport = { ...report, schemaVersion: -1 };
  const saved: CoreEvidenceDocument = schemas.evidenceDocumentSchema.parse(document);
  const result: CoreReportRow = schemas.reportRowSchema.parse(row);
  const oldEvidence: Evidence = schemas.evidenceSchema.parse(futureEvidence);
  const oldReport: Report = schemas.reportSchema.parse(futureReport);
  return { saved, result, oldEvidence, oldReport };
}

export async function consumeQualityReportContract(input: unknown): Promise<QualityReport> {
  const version: 1 = QUALITY_REPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION;
  const { qualityReportSchema } = await loadQualityReportSchema();
  const result: QualityReport = qualityReportSchema.parse(input);
  return { ...result, version };
}

// REQ-305・REQ-306: 配布物の共有型と集約関数を追加APIとして使う。
export async function consumeQualityVerdict(input: readonly import('@loomake/core').QualityResult[]) {
  const { loadQualityResultSchema } = await import('@loomake/core');
  const { aggregateCiVerdict } = await import('@loomake/kit');
  const { qualityResultSchema } = await loadQualityResultSchema();
  const verdict: import('@loomake/core').QualityResult = qualityResultSchema.parse(aggregateCiVerdict(input));
  return verdict;
}

// REQ-393: installed declarations preserve the actual Vitest Base and a custom runner.
import { TestRunner, type RunnerTestCase, type TestContext, chai } from 'vitest';
import { defineConfig } from 'vitest/config';
import { createBodyRunner, createBodyRecorder, type BodyContext } from '@loomake/kit';
export const BodyRunner = createBodyRunner(TestRunner);
export const bodyConfig = defineConfig({ test: { runner: './runner.ts' } });
export function consumeBodyRunner(config: ConstructorParameters<typeof TestRunner>[0], context: BodyContext) {
  const runner: TestRunner = new BodyRunner(config);
  const getTestFn: typeof TestRunner.getTestFn = BodyRunner.getTestFn;
  const body = createBodyRecorder(chai);
  const value: number | Promise<number> = body(context, () => 42);
  // @ts-expect-error the public Vitest constructor still requires its configuration
  new BodyRunner();
  // @ts-expect-error the public constructor configuration is not a string
  new BodyRunner('invalid');
  class ExistingRunner extends TestRunner {
    constructor(settings: ConstructorParameters<typeof TestRunner>[0], readonly extra: string) { super(settings); }
    runTask = async (task: RunnerTestCase): Promise<void> => { await TestRunner.getTestFn(task)?.(); };
    override extendTaskContext = (ctx: TestContext): TestContext => ctx;
    literal = 'preserved' as const;
  }
  const Composed = createBodyRunner(ExistingRunner);
  const custom: ExistingRunner = new Composed(config, 'extra');
  const literal: 'preserved' = custom.literal;
  // @ts-expect-error the original custom constructor's second argument remains required
  new Composed(config);
  // @ts-expect-error readonly instance members remain readonly
  custom.extra = 'changed';
  return { runner, getTestFn, custom, literal, value };
}

// [REQ-462] 元bytesとOS不読の公開型。fixtureはコンパイルだけを行う。
import { readInputBytes, InputReadFailure } from '@loomake/kit';
const summaryRawBytes: Buffer = readInputBytes('report.json');
const summaryInputFailure: UsageError = new InputReadFailure('読取り失敗');
void [summaryRawBytes, summaryInputFailure];

// [REQ-460][REQ-463] 新公開契約は旧Evidence/Report型の比較とは独立に利用する。
import { loadSummarySchemas, type EvidenceSummary, type SummaryArtifact } from '@loomake/core';
import { checkArtifactBody, artifactRetention, type ArtifactBodyCheck, type ArtifactRetentionResult } from '@loomake/kit';
export type SummaryVersionContract = Assert<Equal<EvidenceSummary['summaryVersion'], 1>>;
export type SummaryCiAttemptContract = Assert<Equal<NonNullable<EvidenceSummary['ci']>['runAttempt'], string>>;
export type SummaryLocationAttemptContract = Assert<Equal<NonNullable<SummaryArtifact['location']>['runAttempt'], string>>;
export function consumeSummaryArtifact(artifact: SummaryArtifact, bytes: Uint8Array) {
  const checked: ArtifactBodyCheck = checkArtifactBody(artifact, bytes);
  const retention: ArtifactRetentionResult = artifactRetention(artifact, '90d', new Date('2026-11-05T00:00:00Z'));
  const schemas: ReturnType<typeof loadSummarySchemas> = loadSummarySchemas();
  return { checked, retention, schemas };
}

// REQ-473/475/476: 配布した宣言だけから追加の全型と関数を使う。
import { readEvidenceRange, createGitEvidenceReader, type EvidenceRangeEntry, type EvidenceRangeReasonCode, type EvidenceRangeReason, type EvidenceRangeOptions, type EvidenceRange, type GitTreeLookup, type GitBlobText, type GitEvidenceReader } from '@loomake/kit';
import { runReuse, reuseRecordProblem, REUSE_RECORD_VERSION, type ReuseOptions, type ReuseResult, type ReuseOutcome, type ReuseReason, type ReuseReasonCode, type ReuseRecord } from '@loomake/trace';
export type EvidenceRangeReturn = Assert<Equal<ReturnType<typeof readEvidenceRange>, EvidenceRange>>;
export type EvidenceRangeArgument = Assert<Equal<Parameters<typeof readEvidenceRange>[0], EvidenceRangeOptions>>;
export type GitEvidenceReaderReturn = Assert<Equal<ReturnType<typeof createGitEvidenceReader>, GitEvidenceReader>>;
export type GitTreeReturn = Assert<Equal<ReturnType<GitEvidenceReader['treeEntry']>, GitTreeLookup>>;
export type GitBlobReturn = Assert<Equal<ReturnType<GitEvidenceReader['readText']>, GitBlobText>>;
export type EvidenceEntryContract = Assert<Equal<Extract<EvidenceRange, { allowed: true }>['entries'][number], EvidenceRangeEntry>>;
export type EvidenceReasonContract = Assert<Equal<Extract<EvidenceRange, { allowed: false }>['reasons'][number], EvidenceRangeReason>>;
export type EvidenceReasonCodeContract = Assert<Equal<EvidenceRangeReason['code'], EvidenceRangeReasonCode>>;
export type ReuseReturn = Assert<Equal<ReturnType<typeof runReuse>, ReuseResult>>;
export type ReuseArgument = Assert<Equal<Parameters<typeof runReuse>[0], ReuseOptions>>;
export type ReuseProblemReturn = Assert<Equal<ReturnType<typeof reuseRecordProblem>, string | undefined>>;
export type ReuseOutcomeContract = Assert<Equal<ReuseResult['outcome'], ReuseOutcome>>;
export type ReuseReasonContract = Assert<Equal<ReuseResult['reasons'][number], ReuseReason>>;
export type ReuseReasonCodeContract = Assert<Equal<ReuseReason['code'], ReuseReasonCode>>;
export type ReuseVersionContract = Assert<Equal<ReuseRecord['reuseVersion'], typeof REUSE_RECORD_VERSION>>;
